audience: construction and real-estate firms that manage customers, sales contracts and receivables in Sienge

useCases.title: Find customers added this month
useCases.text: List the customers of the account and filter them by create date. Open one customer to read its phones, addresses and agents.

useCases.title: Review the receivable bills of a customer
useCases.text: List the receivable bills of one customer, using its customer id. Then list the installments of one bill with their due dates and amounts.

useCases.title: Read the sales contracts of an enterprise
useCases.text: List the sales contracts, filtered by enterprise or customer. Open one contract to read its customers, units, payment conditions and brokers.

useCases.title: Track purchase orders that wait for delivery
useCases.text: List the purchase orders by status or supplier. Open one order to read its totals and payment condition.

useCases.title: Create a customer record
useCases.text: Check the customer list for the CPF or CNPJ first. Then create a natural person with a CPF, or a legal person with a CNPJ. The create call is not retried.
